title: A relayed root cause names the code line that acts, not a message string
why: Consultant 01:46 CST Nov 14 (relayed): it relayed a root cause (the merge-tool batch brake) from a cite string without reading the code path; the coordinator found merge.py:1658 says the opposite (see merge-brake-text-stale). The refusal text and BATCH_CITE still said the brake held; the code no longer enforced it. Sighting 03:24 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:24, its own error, and triage copied it): the coordinator told a lane to say #3005 "cuts one macOS step" without reading the PR's diff, then corrected to "removes only Windows" the same way; triage copied the macOS wording into macos-jobs-gated-by-scope and then the Windows wording into an answer. The diff (head 013e6d573) drops both runs. Guard the coordinator proposes: a claim about what a PR changes cites that PR's diff or body, never memory of an earlier message. Sighting 04:08 CST Nov 14 (coordinator's own, 04:06, relayed): a report named #3233's branch name (main-merge-grant-bullet, REST head.ref) as a roadmap step id; no such step exists, so triage could not mark it. Same class as the earlier cites: a name copied from one place presented as an id from another. Guard the coordinator proposes (triage agrees it fits this step; fit by title only): a report names a step id only from a roadmap read, never from a branch name; a check that each step id in a relay resolves to a file on the record branch. Triage's own earlier sighting on this step (the #3005 "(a) Windows-only" answer from stale step text) is the same family.
source: Consultant 01:46 CST Nov 14 (relayed). Same family: act-claims-read-back (unstarted: a claim about an act is read back), the triage readings corrected on Nov 13 to 14 (#3279, the shard-order fix). A text string is a claim, not the code.
note: Triage 01:53 CST Nov 14: the consultant names the step for itself. The mistake: a cause taken from a message the code prints, not from the line that decides. The guard that would have stopped it: a report that names a cause names the file and line that acts, or says "text only, code unread". Not built, not queued beyond this step; the consultant owns the design. Not started.
